compiled_state.title: As a bridge operator, I want a health/audit module that measures convergence and per-type parity, so that closure criteria (sc-1 80% fsck drop, sc-2 +/-5 parity across 3 passes) are observably met.
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Health/audit module at dso_reconciler/health.py. Writes bridge_state/health/<pass>.json with pre/post fsck totals and per-type open counts. Provides 'dso_reconciler health summary' CLI.

## Done Definitions
- Every reconciler pass writes bridge_state/health/<pass>.json with pre-pass fsck total, post-pass fsck total, and per-type open counts ← Satisfies: sc-1, sc-2
- After four bootstrap bands complete, latest health record shows total fsck <=20% of the pre-bootstrap fsck total captured at the start of bootstrap band 1 execution ← Satisfies: sc-1
- 3 consecutive post-bootstrap health records where the window spans at least 10 local ticket mutations (creates, updates, or closures) all show per-type drift within +/-5 ← Satisfies: sc-2

## Considerations
- [Observability] Health JSON schema is consumed by external heartbeat alert (7004-3121-e68b-4d80); use a stable schema and document it.
- [Baseline capture] Health module must snapshot the baseline fsck total before bootstrap band 1 applies any mutations, so the >=80% relative drop is computable.

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
